decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to enable the recurring of Arclight Phoenix. It also utilizes spells that help with card draw and selection, as well as removal to clear the way for quick attacks. The presence of cards like Thing in the Ice and Brazen Borrower provide additional threats and disruption to the opponent's game plan. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, aggression, and resilience.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful Spirit creatures to build a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent quickly. By playing efficient creatures like Empyrean Eagle and Supreme Phantom alongside disruptive spells like Spell Queller, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game while dealing damage consistently. Collected Company provides additional creature synergy and allows for explosive turns. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the deck's color requirements in order to maximize the effectiveness of its aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on using flying Spirit creatures to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. By combining the evasive power of Empyrean Eagle and Watcher of the Spheres with the disruptive abilities of cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent. Collected Company provides additional creature value and tempo advantage, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The mana base combines Azorius and green sources to ensure smooth and consistent gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and disruption spells in order to quickly deplete their resources and control the board. By utilizing various aggressive creatures like Champion of Dusk, Gifted Aetherborn, and Knight of the Ebon Legion, along with powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control throughout the game. With the help of disruption spells like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Heartless Act, the deck can efficiently remove threats and disrupt opponent's game plan while pushing towards victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize artifacts as the core of an aggressive strategy, using cards like Ornithopter, Stonecoil Serpent, and Ensoul Artifact to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes ways to protect its threats with cards like Stubborn Denial and Glass Casket, allowing for a more versatile game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and recursion to the deck, ensuring a steady stream of threats throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Champion of Dusk and Knight of the Ebon Legion, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to buff its creatures and generate card advantage. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly with its aggressive creatures and removal spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Jeskai Ascendancy to create a powerful combo with creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Sylvan Caryatid. By casting cheap spells and untapping creatures with Jeskai Ascendancy, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent. The addition of cards like Tamiyo, Collector of Tales and Treasure Cruise further supports the combo strategy by providing card selection and draw options. Jegantha, the Wellspring also serves as a versatile companion option for additional mana acceleration.

The primary focus of this deck is to use Jeskai Ascendancy along with other cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Sylvan Caryatid to create a powerful combo engine. By cycling through your deck with cards like Treasure Cruise and Expressive Iteration, you can generate significant advantage and eventually overwhelm your opponent. Tamiyo, Collector of Tales helps with card selection and recursion, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp. The deck also includes removal spells like Chained to the Rocks and Radiant Flames to control the board as you assemble your combo pieces.

This deck focuses on using cheap spells to quickly fill up the graveyard and bring back Arclight Phoenix from exile. It also relies on disruptive threats like Thing in the Ice and Crackling Drake to pressure the opponent. The deck includes a mix of card draw, removal, and counter spells to control the board and protect its creatures. By efficiently cycling through the deck and casting spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of flying Phoenixes and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage to outlast opponents. It also utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset to generate card advantage and maintain control of the board. The mana base allows for consistency in casting spells and utilizing the deck's powerful control elements. The companion, Kaheera, adds an additional threat and can provide value throughout the game. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies, outvalue them in card advantage, and ultimately win through attrition.

This deck focuses on a variety of control elements using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the key card for card advantage and selection. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, ramp spells, and versatile threats to control the board and outvalue the opponent. Nahiri, the Harbinger and Bring to Light provide flexibility in finding answers, while cards like Klothys, God of Destiny and Omnath, Locus of Creation offer additional utility and pressure. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the diverse color requirements of the cards in the deck.

The main concept of this combo Lotus Field deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Wolfwillow Haven, and Lotus Field, and then be able to "go off" by untapping Lotus Field multiple times in a turn using spells like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. The deck also includes ways to search for specific combo pieces or answers using Fae of Wishes and Strategic Planning. The end goal is to generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck with spells like Dig Through Time and Peer into the Abyss to win the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost artifact creatures and equipment to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By consistently playing artifacts that can be quickly buffed or turned into threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recursion of key cards, ensuring the deck can maintain a strong offensive presence throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts to build a strong aggro strategy, focusing on quickly developing a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and buffs. The deck includes cards like Ingenious Smith and Ensoul Artifact to enhance the artifacts on the battlefield, with additional support from cards like All That Glitters and The Blackstaff of Waterdeep. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recursion from the graveyard, enhancing the deck's resilience and aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing Jeskai Ascendancy to generate infinite mana and draw cards, while also utilizing Omnath, Locus of Creation and other cards to create a powerful board presence. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion, providing additional value. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent and achieve victory through a powerful synergy of cards. It also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistent mana base and access to various colors required for the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize various low-cost creatures and spells to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Go Blank. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard to enable Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Dreadhorde Arcanist to generate value. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional recursion for key creatures and enchantments. The mana base is designed to consistently cast the deck's spells and allow for multiple color requirements. Overall, the deck focuses on aggression and disruption to overwhelm the opponent.
